subject: Exclusive Summer Discounts Inside!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready for the summer season with our exclusive discounts on a wide range of products. From stylish swimwear to outdoor accessories, we have everything you need for a fantastic summer. Don't miss out on these limited-time offers and upgrade your summer wardrobe today. Visit our website or nearest store to explore more. Hurry, the sale ends soon! Best regards, The Summer Deals Team
